maddeler.e:
نرتضخ (form VIII)
# نَرْتَضِخُ (nartaḍiḵu) /nar.ta.dˤi.xu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# نُرْتَضَخُ (nurtaḍaḵu) /nur.ta.dˤa.xu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# نَرْتَضِخَ (nartaḍiḵa) /nar.ta.dˤi.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# نُرْتَضَخَ (nurtaḍaḵa) /nur.ta.dˤa.x
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
